Mariko's Dream Roosterfish Catch in San José del Cabo

Fishing Report Jan 19 Written by EXOTIC FISH-CABO

A Dream Roosterfish Catch Along the Coast of San José del Cabo

January 2026 brought a special fishing experience for Mariko and her boyfriend Ben in the waters surrounding San José del Cabo.

For Mariko, this wasn't just another day on the ocean. She had long dreamed of catching a roosterfish, one of the most recognizable and exciting game fish found along the coast of Baja California Sur.

Joining Exotic Fish Cabo for a private fishing adventure departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, the couple headed out early in the morning, eager to turn that dream into reality.

As they explored the coastline, anticipation grew with every passing moment.

Roosterfish are famous for their distinctive comb-like dorsal fins, powerful runs, and remarkable fighting ability.

Suddenly, Mariko's fishing rod bent sharply, and the reel began to spin.

She had hooked the fish she had been hoping to catch.

What followed was an exciting battle as the roosterfish resisted, testing her patience and determination.

With Ben cheering her on and assistance from the crew, Mariko carefully worked the fish closer to the boat.

After a memorable fight, the unmistakable silhouette of a roosterfish finally appeared near the surface.

Mariko had done it.

Her dream of catching this remarkable species had become reality, creating an unforgettable moment shared with Ben.

The experience was about more than the fish itself. It was the excitement of the challenge, the satisfaction of achieving a personal fishing goal, and the joy of sharing that achievement with someone special.

For Mariko and Ben, this was a fishing adventure they would remember long after leaving Los Cabos.

Trip Highlights

  • Date: January 2026

  • Departure: Puerto Los Cabos Marina, San José del Cabo

  • Anglers: Mariko and Ben

  • Species caught: Roosterfish

  • Fishing area: Coastal waters near San José del Cabo

  • Catch highlight: Mariko's first dream roosterfish catch

  • Experience: Private coastal fishing charter

Roosterfish (Nematistius pectoralis) are particularly sought after for their impressive dorsal fins and strong fighting ability.

Unlike many offshore game fish, roosterfish are commonly encountered in coastal waters, where their activity can be influenced by baitfish movements, water temperature, currents, and seasonal conditions.

Each fishing trip offers different opportunities, and catches can never be guaranteed.
